ache.title: Lesson one: how to acquire Faycal. Hmm.
ache.note: This starter guide opens with how to get Faycal, the ‘legendary’ unit, before it even reaches his skills. Labels like ‘legendary’ do a lot of selling, and a battle demo shows him at his best so you picture him on your team. The ‘don’t miss out’ at the end is the nudge.
watch: a demo that shows him at his peak
ache.tip: Before learning how to acquire a unit, ask what you’d do differently with him. If it’s ‘not much’, skip him.
lines: legendary is just a rarity label
demo footage is the trailer, not the movie
missing out is allowed. it’s restful

title: Character Starter Guide: Faycal | Sword of Convallaria
excerpt: In this episode, we dive into the legendary character Faycal from Sword of Convallaria. Learn how to acquire Faycal, his role as a Seeker against destroyers, and explore his traits, skills, and abilities in-depth. I'll also provide a demo showcasing his potential in battle, alongside some advanced strategies. Don't miss out on mastering Faycal's critical abilities and maximizing his impact on the battlefield. Stay tuned for more guides and tips!
